transcript: Whoever squeezes lemon on chayote will never need the pharmacy again. Put in the blender half a chayote, one cup of cucumber, the juice of one lemon and a glass of water, blend for one minute and drink it on an empty stomach. Chayote is one of the most anti-inflammatory foods that exists and almost no one uses it. It's rich in potassium that naturally regulates blood pressure and in fiber that cleanses the intestine without irritating it. Cucumber hydrates and helps the kidneys release what they've been retaining. Lemon activates the liver from the first hour and drags out accumulated toxins and water binds everything together so nutrients reach quickly where they need to go. This juice reduces inflammation, detoxifies the liver, cleanses the kidneys, resets the digestive system, regulates pressure and improves the skin. In just a few days you'll notice that swelling goes down, that digestion works better, that skin clears up and that you feel lighter than you felt in months. Save this recipe to always have it available but I want you to understand something. Your liver doesn't get saturated only by what you eat, it gets saturated by how you live, stress overloads it every day. Your kidneys don't weaken only from lack of water, they weaken from the fear and anxiety you carry. Your pressure doesn't rise only from salt, it rises from the cortisol that stress triggers. That's why there are people who eat healthy and still remain inflamed, tired and with high pressure because they take care of what goes in but don't calm what destroys them from within. This juice cleanses today but if stress continues tomorrow your organs get saturated again. Write in the comments natural health if you're going to prepare this tomorrow and if you want to cleanse your body from the root calm what saturates your organs and stop depending on the pharmacy. I've been learning in silence for more than 20 years how to do it and everything I know is inside the Path Back to Calm. The link is in my profile.
